text_1308485034f1: Your route, location and rolling-stock knowledge with separate inventories and CSV imports for your TF account.
text_24780c3c9616: Add location knowledge via DS100 above the list, or select a row to renew it. Valid until is limited to one year. Search, sort arrows and validity colours help you review the inventory; CSV import is below it.
text_376cf04ec77f: Import your rolling-stock inventory with the columns Baureihe and Gültig bis. Check the preview and confirm the import. Your saved inventory is shown below. Existing conflicting entries are retained; editing will follow later.
text_8562cceb9457: Route knowledge → Display route knowledge shows stored knowledge and GPS additions on the map. The import is below it. Choose your route CSV and review the account, preview and map. Only Confirm import saves permanently for your TF account; the file selection and preview then clear. Cancel removes only the preview. Confirmed imports remain authoritative. Local knowledge and vehicle classes keep their own tabs. Open the separate Create or edit route knowledge tile for manual routes.
text_8f6a274eb4f8: The module has Route knowledge, Local knowledge and Vehicle classes tabs. Route knowledge contains Display route knowledge. Open the separate Create or edit route knowledge tile for manual routes.
